# BlueTick Academy

> BlueTick Academy is Bangalore's placement-first, AI-native digital marketing training institute. We run in-person classes in Indiranagar and Hoodi plus live online batches, with a 100% placement record and a 10,000+ alumni network across MNCs and startups.

BlueTick Academy teaches a 2026, AI-native digital marketing curriculum — SEO, Google Ads, social media, performance marketing, analytics and generative-AI tools — through hands-on live projects, certifications and dedicated placement support. Programs suit freshers, students, job-seekers and working professionals; no coding or prior marketing experience is required. Tracks: PCP (3 months), PGCP (5 months) and ELEVATE™ (7 months).
